description: Perf lane fixes: keyword sorts with a custom missing value across segments (missing and foreign values in one ordinal gap, fieldless segments), unmapped_type sorts honouring missing, numbers indexed as text as written (main fields, multi-fields, copy_to, bulk fast path of 70 items) and ignore_above counting UTF-16 units.

root_cause.reason: Fielddata is disabled on [__anonymous_] in [esm-ua]. Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document field data like aggregations and sorting, so these operations are disabled by default. Please use a keyword field instead. Alternatively, set fielddata=true on [__anonymous_] in order to load field data by uninverting the inverted index. Note that this can use significant memory.
